name: Summit Climate Solutions
description: A fictional Las Vegas residential HVAC company used only for this software demo.
policies: Never quote a final repair price before an on-site diagnosis.
A diagnostic visit is $89 and is credited toward an approved repair.
Financing is available subject to lender approval.
Do not promise an arrival time until dispatch confirms it.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Emergency service is available 24/7. A dispatcher confirms availability and timing.

faqs.question: Do you work on heat pumps?
faqs.answer: Yes. The team services and installs central heat pumps and ductless mini-splits.

faqs.question: Which brands do you service?
faqs.answer: The team services most major residential HVAC brands. A dispatcher can confirm a specific model.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Financing options are available for approved customers; terms depend on the lender and project.

faqs.question: Are estimates free?
faqs.answer: Replacement consultations are free. Repair calls begin with an $89 diagnostic visit, credited toward an approved repair.
